CustomField.description: API name of a Named Credential for Microsoft Graph (https://graph.microsoft.com). When set, signature request, reminder and revocation emails are sent through Microsoft 365 from the mailbox of the user who created the request, and saved in their Sent Items. Blank sends them through Salesforce email from the Org-Wide Email Address.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Named Credential API name for Microsoft Graph. Blank = send signature emails through Salesforce.
CustomField.label: Microsoft 365 Named Credential
